skill.name: x-article-publisher-skill
skill.description: Guidance for preparing and publishing article content on X/Twitter.
skill.summary: Prepare article content for publication on X/Twitter.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: The two static findings are hardcoded GitHub repository links in documentation and metadata, not executable network behavior. No prompt injection, data exfiltration, or business-logic abuse was found in SKILL.md.

finding_verdicts.reason: The URL is a source repository reference in frontmatter. It does not trigger network access, collect data, or instruct the assistant to contact an external service.
The URL appears in a documentation link for more information. It is not executable code and does not request transmission of user data.

content.value_statement: Publishing long ideas on X/Twitter requires concise framing and clear posting steps. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through article-focused publishing preparation.
actual_capabilities: Identifies X/Twitter article publishing as the supported workflow.
Provides a simple usage trigger for article publishing tasks.
Guides assistants to provide publishing patterns for X/Twitter.
Links users to the upstream source repository for more details.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts or an API client.
Does not authenticate with X/Twitter or publish posts automatically.
Does not schedule posts, manage media uploads, or track analytics.
Provides brief guidance, so users must supply article content and goals.

use_cases.title: Promote a New Article
use_cases.description: Turn an article summary into X/Twitter-ready publishing guidance and post angles.

use_cases.title: Share Product Updates
use_cases.description: Prepare a concise X/Twitter publishing plan for a launch article or feature announcement.

use_cases.title: Adapt Technical Writing
use_cases.description: Convert a technical article into clearer social publishing guidance for X/Twitter audiences.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Basic Article Post
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for one article announcement.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to help me publish an article on X/Twitter. My article is about [topic]. Create a concise post plan.

prompt_templates.title: Turn an Article into a Thread
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for a multi-post article summary.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to adapt my article into an X/Twitter thread. Highlight the main idea, supporting points, and final call to action.

prompt_templates.title: Tailor a Post for a Specific Audience
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request with audience and positioning constraints.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to prepare X/Twitter publishing guidance for my article. The audience is [audience], and the goal is [goal].

prompt_templates.title: Build a Complete Publishing Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced request for planning, review, and publishing steps.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an X/Twitter article publishing workflow with draft review, message variants, timing notes, and compliance checks.

output_examples.input: I need to publish an article about a new analytics feature on X/Twitter.
output_examples.output: The assistant provides a short launch post, thread outline, audience angle, and final call to action.

output_examples.input: Adapt my technical blog post for developers on X/Twitter.
output_examples.output: The assistant creates clear posting guidance, simplifies the article hook, and suggests follow-up points for a thread.

output_examples.input: Help me plan publication for a research article next week.
output_examples.output: The assistant outlines draft review steps, posting timing, message variants, and items to verify before publishing.

best_practices: Provide the article title, target audience, and publishing goal.
Review generated posts for accuracy, tone, and platform policy compliance.
Keep sensitive account details outside prompts unless they are required.
anti_patterns: Do not expect the skill to publish directly to X/Twitter.
Do not provide account tokens, passwords, or private credentials.
Do not use generated posts without checking claims and links.

faq.question: Does this skill publish posts automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides guidance and patterns for publishing articles on X/Twitter.

faq.question: Does it require X/Twitter API access?
faq.answer: No API access is included in the skill file. Users handle any platform access separately.

faq.question: Can Claude use this skill?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What content should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the article topic, audience, goal, key points, links, and tone requirements.

faq.question: Can it create thread ideas?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide an assistant to turn article points into X/Twitter publishing patterns.

faq.question: Is this a full social media manager?
faq.answer: No. It is a lightweight guidance skill, not a scheduler, analytics tool, or posting client.
